#!/bin/bash
# exp-032: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct SICA vs SC on ProofWriter(600)
# Server: westd-16639, GPU 0, K=12, T=0.7, seed=42
# 600 problems, estimated 2-4h

set -e
cd /root/autodl-tmp/sica_project/symb_invariant_consensus
export PATH=/root/miniconda3/bin:\$PATH

# ── Config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
MODEL=\"/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct\"
PORT=8000
GPU_ID=0
K=12
TEMPERATURE=0.7
MAX_TOKENS=4096
SEED=42
RESULTS_DIR=\"results/exp032_qwen25_14b_pw600\"
mkdir -p \"\$RESULTS_DIR\"

echo \"=== [\$(date)] exp-032: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct SICA vs SC (PW600) ===\"
echo \"Model: \$MODEL\"
echo \"GPU: \$GPU_ID, Port: \$PORT\"
echo \"K=\$K, T=\$TEMPERATURE, max_tokens=\$MAX_TOKENS, seed=\$SEED\"
echo \"Data: proofwriter_full.json (600 problems)\"

# ── Pre-flight checks ──────────────────────────────────────────
echo \"\"
echo \"=== Pre-flight checks ===\"

if [ ! -d \"\$MODEL\" ]; then
    echo \"ERROR: Model not found: \$MODEL\"
    exit 1
fi
echo \"Model dir: OK\"

for f in data/proofwriter_full.json data/empty.json; do
    if [ ! -f \"\$f\" ]; then
        echo \"ERROR: Data file not found: \$f\"
        exit 1
    fi
done
echo \"Data files: OK\"

GPU_MEM=\$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i \$GPU_ID 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
echo \"GPU \$GPU_ID memory used: \${GPU_MEM} MiB\"
if [ \"\$GPU_MEM\" -gt 1000 ]; then
    echo \"WARNING: GPU \$GPU_ID has \${GPU_MEM} MiB in use.\"
fi

if curl -s http://localhost:\$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo \"ERROR: Port \$PORT already in use.\"
    exit 1
fi
echo \"Port \$PORT: free\"

# ── Step 1: Start vLLM ────────────────────────────────────────
echo \"\"
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Starting vLLM on GPU \$GPU_ID, port \$PORT ===\"

VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\$GPU_ID python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model \"\$MODEL\" \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
    --port \$PORT \
    --dtype auto \
    --trust-remote-code \
    --enforce-eager \
    > /tmp/vllm_exp032.log 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID=\$!
echo \"vLLM PID: \$VLLM_PID\"

echo \"Waiting for vLLM to be ready...\"
READY=0
for i in \$(seq 1 300); do
    if curl -s http://localhost:\$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo \"vLLM ready after \${i}s\"
        READY=1
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo \"ERROR: vLLM process died. Check /tmp/vllm_exp032.log\"
        tail -30 /tmp/vllm_exp032.log
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

if [ \$READY -eq 0 ]; then
    echo \"ERROR: vLLM did not start within 300s.\"
    tail -30 /tmp/vllm_exp032.log
    kill \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi

# ── Step 2: Run SICA pipeline ─────────────────────────────────
echo \"\"
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Running SICA pipeline: PW 600, K=\$K ===\"
PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -u run_full_mvp.py \
    --mode vllm \
    --k \$K \
    --temperature \$TEMPERATURE \
    --max-tokens \$MAX_TOKENS \
    --api-base \"http://localhost:\$PORT/v1\" \
    --model auto \
    --seed \$SEED \
    --math-data data/empty.json \
    --pw-data data/proofwriter_full.json \
    --folio-data data/empty.json \
    --output \"\$RESULTS_DIR/exp032_results.json\" \
    --save-intermediates \
    --resume \
    2>&1 | tee \"\$RESULTS_DIR/exp032_qwen25_14b_pw600.log\"

EXIT_CODE=\$?

# ── Step 3: Cleanup ───────────────────────────────────────────
echo \"\"
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Stopping vLLM ===\"
kill \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true

echo \"\"
echo \"Results: \$RESULTS_DIR/exp032_results.json\"
echo \"Log: \$RESULTS_DIR/exp032_qwen25_14b_pw600.log\"
echo \"vLLM log: /tmp/vllm_exp032.log\"
echo \"EXIT_CODE=\$EXIT_CODE\"
echo \"EXP032_DONE\"
SCRIPTEOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/sica_project/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp032_pw600.sh && echo 'Script created OK'"
